column_description: Unique identifier for each access log.
ID of the asset accessed. may be NULL.
ID of the user who accessed the asset. may be NULL.
Date the asset was accessed. may be NULL.
Type of access (e.g., view, download). always exactly one of 'view', 'download'. may be NULL.
IP address of the user who accessed the asset. may be NULL.
User agent string of the device used to access the asset. may be NULL.
Description of the access event. may be NULL.
